race.comment: HELL TO PAY (1) was plain over the mile in BM78 company but is eased from Saturday grade, draws barrier 1, claims 2kg and has the proven 1400m record to rebound. Bold showing anticipated. DIVINE JUSTICE (6) is chasing four wins in a row, has the key hoop reuniting and loves this trip. Is another to strongly consider. SNITZSTREAM (16) gets in light and possesses good tactical speed. Boasts a solid record here and strips rock-hard fit. She can have a say in the finish. EXCEED SPEED (3) just missed first-up in a hot form reference. Less effective last time on a wet deck, so will appreciate to getting onto firmer footing and gets another key booking in Maloney. Worth another look.
